head: codex/5512-runtime-v3-csm-coverage-filter
title: [v0.91.7][tooling][CI] Split Runtime v3 CSM coverage filters by crate
body:
Closes #5512

## Summary
- match only the exact bounded Runtime v3/CSM bridge expression
- run ADL CSM coverage without foreign Runtime v3 or nonexistent binary selectors
- run Runtime v3 auth, supervision, and topology coverage in `adl-runtime`
- prove both summaries are composed with distinct nonzero fixtures
- prove a near-match expression remains on the generic fail-closed path

## Validation
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_pr_fast_coverage_lane.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_pr_fast_test_lane.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_path_policy.sh`
- real nextest selection: 133 ADL tests and 31 Runtime v3 tests
- exact-head subagent review clean after fixing both findings

No Runtime v2 source changes and no AWS execution.
